The low-limb add additionally folds a carry-into-mid step (mid += 1) when both the low and mid additions overflow, and the final high-limb add returns its overflow flag. Matches the CRT __add_12 pattern. Called by sub_597621 and sub_5976E8.

operations.description: Low-limb add: OverflowCheckedUnsignedAddition(*a1, *a2, a1) — a1[0] += a2[0], returns carry
Mid-limb increment: OverflowCheckedUnsignedAddition(a1[1], 1, a1+1) — propagates a carry into the mid dword
If both the low-limb add and the mid increment overflow, ++a1[2] — cascades carry to the high dword
Mid-limb add: OverflowCheckedUnsignedAddition(a1[1], a2[1], a1+1) — a1[1] += a2[1], returns carry
If the mid-limb add overflows, ++a1[2] — carry to the high dword
return OverflowCheckedUnsignedAddition(a1[2], a2[2], a1+2) — high-limb add, result is the final carry flag
